title: LAX vs. The OGz: a family divided
summary: Santana and Ortiz defend the LAX identity against former members Homicide and Hernandez. Konnan and King drive a struggle over loyalty, leadership and who owns the group’s legacy.

chapters.title: LAX win the street fight
chapters.result: Santana and Ortiz defeat Homicide and Hernandez in a 5150 Street Fight.
chapters.context: Victory does not end the dispute: The OGz attack afterward and take the championship belts, keeping the war over LAX’s identity alive.

chapters.title: Concrete Jungle showdown
chapters.result: Konnan, Santana and Ortiz defeat King, Homicide and Hernandez.
chapters.context: The exposed-ring stipulation supplies a brutal setting for the faction leaders to join their teams in the decisive confrontation.
